description: This file contains a module for verifying ONNX models, including classes, functions, and methods for comparing ONNX and PyTorch outputs, handling ONNX sessions, and performing model export verification.

classes.name: OnnxBackend
classes.description: Enum class for ONNX backend used for export verification, deprecated in version 2.7.

classes.name: VerificationOptions
classes.description: Data class for options controlling ONNX export verification, deprecated in version 2.7.

methods.name: _flatten_tuples
methods.description: Recursively flattens nested tuples into a list.

methods.name: _to_numpy
methods.description: Converts various input types (torch.Tensor, list, dict, etc.) to numpy arrays.

methods.name: _inline_flatten_list
methods.description: Flattens a list of lists/tuples into a single list.

methods.name: _unpack_to_numpy
methods.description: Unpacks and converts inputs to numpy arrays, handling quantized tensors.

methods.name: _run_onnx
methods.description: Runs inference on an ONNX session with given inputs.

methods.name: _ort_session
methods.description: Creates an ONNX Runtime inference session.

methods.name: _onnx_backend_session
methods.description: Creates an ONNX backend session based on specified backend.

methods.name: _compare_onnx_pytorch_outputs_in_np
methods.description: Compares ONNX and PyTorch outputs in numpy arrays, with tolerance checks.

methods.name: _compare_onnx_pytorch_outputs
methods.description: Compares ONNX and PyTorch outputs, handling None filtering and flattening.

methods.name: _prepare_input_for_pytorch
methods.description: Prepares inputs for PyTorch model execution.

methods.name: _prepare_input_for_onnx
methods.description: Prepares inputs for ONNX backend execution, with optional flattening.

methods.name: _try_clone_model
methods.description: Attempts to deep clone a model to prevent mutation during verification.

methods.name: _compare_onnx_pytorch_model
methods.description: Runs ONNX and PyTorch models with given inputs and compares outputs.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Main function to verify ONNX export against a PyTorch model, deprecated in version 2.7.
